basis: Malignant astrocytic tumor arising in the cerebral hemisphere.
Inflammation confined to placental chorionic villi; placenta has no axis. Infection or autoimmunity is not established by this umbrella definition.
Isolated skeletal sclerosis and abnormal ossification; extraskeletal abnormalities are uncommon.
Autoimmune blistering skin disease; oral mucosal erosions occur in approximately one third, with reported frequencies near the 30% threshold.
Mitochondrial metabolic defect; heart failure and mitochondrial myopathy each affect roughly >=30% of reported cases. Respiratory failure alone does not establish lung damage.
Catecholamine-producing adrenal medullary tumor; hypertension does not establish direct cardiovascular damage, and cardiomyopathy is a minority complication.
Brain malformations and polydactyly define the syndrome; septal defects and mitral regurgitation occur in 30-79%. Renal ectopia alone does not establish damage.
Inherited atrial rhythm disorder; embolic complications are not intrinsic organ involvement.
Disorders of intrahepatic or extrahepatic bile ducts; the endocrine parent does not match the explicit anatomical definition.
Sarcoma arising primarily in the pancreas; no endocrine origin is specified.
Clonal myeloid proliferation involving marrow and blood; no additional organ damage is established across this heterogeneous group.
Intestinal bacterial colonization produces toxin that blocks neuromuscular transmission; ocular, bowel and respiratory symptoms do not establish separate organ injury.
Malignant glandular tumor originating in an extrahepatic bile duct.
Immunodeficiency with lymphoproliferation; developmental delay reported in 30-79%, though annotations conflict. Bronchiectasis is a separately coded infection sequela.
Aspirin-exacerbated inflammatory airway disease defined by asthma and nasal polyposis; both upper and lower airways are pulmonary.
Ovarian malignancy of reproductive tissue; endocrine differentiation or hormone dysfunction is not established across this group.
Sarcoma arising in the intima of large blood vessels; embolic spread does not establish common involvement of another organ.
Autoimmune inflammation of orbital tissues with preserved thyroid function; thyroid dysfunction is not part of this concept.
Peroxisomal neurometabolic disease with defining developmental impairment and hepatic failure; sensorineural hearing loss occurs in 30-79%. Cataracts occur in 5-29%.
Melanoma arising in the choroid of the eye; melanocytic histology does not imply skin involvement.
Hypomyelinating spastic paraplegia; pes cavus in 3/3 and sensorineural hearing loss in 30-79%. Gaze and bladder findings reflect neural dysfunction.
Mucinous adenocarcinoma originating in the urinary bladder, which belongs to the renal axis.
Peroxisomal disorder with defining brain and liver disease; retinal degeneration affects 80-99%. Cap excludes skeletal disease (80-99%) and hearing loss (30-79%).
Paraneoplastic dysfunction of the digestive system; the generic definition does not establish an autoimmune mechanism or another affected organ.
Structural disorder of the tongue; the mouth belongs to the gastrointestinal axis.
